def solution():
    units_sold = 350
    selling_price = 40
    inventory_levels = [100, 150, 200]  # Oldest to newest
    unit_costs = [20, 25, 30]

    revenue = units_sold * selling_price
    units_remaining = units_sold
    cogs = 0

    for i in range(len(inventory_levels) - 1, -1, -1):
        units_from_batch = min(units_remaining, inventory_levels[i])
        cogs += units_from_batch * unit_costs[i]
        units_remaining -= units_from_batch

    gross_profit = revenue - cogs
    return round(gross_profit)
